Container.Name: gridcraft
Container.Overview: GridCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Excel in Rust, from the ArtCraft Crafting Apps. This container serves its browser (WebAssembly) build with nginx. All work happens in your browser: Open/Save use the browser file picker and downloads, so nothing is stored on the server and no volume is needed. WebGPU and clipboard APIs require a secure context, so reach it over HTTPS (for example via Unraid's Tailscale integration with Tailscale Serve, or a reverse proxy) or via localhost. Early alpha software.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI (container port 8080). Unique per app, see PORTS.md.
